title: Herb Wrapped Jamaican Vine Leaves Skewers
description: A fresh and creamy solo dinner dish featuring vine leaves with a char-grill flavor, made with ayurvedic sattvic friendly ingredients. This dish is perfect for a quiet evening meal.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
In a blender, combine coconut cream, scotch bonnet pepper, curry powder, thyme, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Add the blended mixture to a bowl and stir in olive oil.
Lay a vine leaf flat on a work surface, with the stem end facing you.
Place about 1 tablespoon of the coconut cream mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package.
Repeat with the remaining leaves and filling.
Thread the filled vine leaves onto skewers, leaving a little space between each leaf.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking, then grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the leaves are slightly charred.
Serve the herb wrapped Jamaican vine leaves skewers hot, garnished with fresh thyme.
